## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test --all-features` passes.
- [ ] `cargo fmt -- --check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -Dwarnings` passes.
- [ ] New or changed behavior is covered by a test.
- [ ] Code and tests follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/tafia/calamine/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
